description: This file defines the SelectionBuilder class, a helper utility for constructing and executing SQL selection clauses within Android's database framework. It provides methods for building complex WHERE clauses, managing table joins, and executing queries, updates, and deletes on an SQLite database. The class emphasizes programmatic, chainable construction of SQL commands to facilitate safer and more manageable database interactions in Android applications.

classes.name: SelectionBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for dynamically building SQL selection queries with support for chaining clauses, mapping columns for joins, and executing queries, updates, and deletions on an SQLiteDatabase.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the builder, clearing table name, selection clauses, and arguments to allow reuse.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Appends a SQL WHERE clause with optional parameters, combining multiple clauses with AND.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Sets the table name for the SQL operations; should only be called once per builder instance.

methods.name: mapToTable
methods.description: Specifies a join by mapping a column to a fully qualified table.column name.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Defines a new column based on a custom SQL expression, useful for aggregates or subqueries.

methods.name: getSelection
methods.description: Returns the current SQL WHERE clause accumulated so far.

methods.name: getSelectionArgs
methods.description: Returns the array of selection arguments corresponding to '?' placeholders in the WHERE clause.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SELECT query on the specified database with the constructed selection, returning a Cursor.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Executes an UPDATE statement on the database based on the built selection and provided ContentValues.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE operation on the database for the constructed selection.
